mathematical_domain: Real third-order Wiener chaos in the standard two-dimensional Gaussian \(L^2\) space, with exact \(L^4/L^2\) extremal and sharp transverse stability inequalities.
scientific_integrity: All universal claims are proved by explicit Gaussian-moment identities and nonnegative quadratic/factorization arguments; a dependency-free exact-arithmetic checker corroborates the polynomial identity. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two independent real standard Gaussian coordinates and cubic Wick chaoses. The exact upper endpoint includes a classical rank-one Hermite example; the novel component is the full-space lower bound with the sharp transverse stability remainder. A historically equivalent unindexed binary-cubic invariant identity remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp fourth-moment stability for binary third Gaussian chaos
